items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: Sam Galata was a good piano player, he played by notes.

ctx.x: Yeah, born and raised right here. there was a fellow downtown, I was forgetting him, they called Sam Galata. Sam Galata, yeah. Sam Galata was a good piano player, he played by notes. But he used to play all that kind of fashion music, you know. Didn't believe in playing no blues and all that. He used to play all book music. Sam Galata, he used to hang around down there by the alley. He was a good piano player.
The alley, was that where Sam Bernard was?
